download_file_from_url: download a file from a URL to a specified directory with optional progress bar
download_file_with_custom_name: download a file from a URL and save it with a custom filename in a directory
download_file_skip_existing: download a file from a URL that skips the download if the file already exists
download_file_without_progress: download a file from a URL to a directory without displaying a progress bar
download_model_checkpoint: download a model checkpoint file from a remote URL to a local directory
